title: Data From a Systematic Literature Review on Eye Movement Modeling Examples
descriptions: Eye movement modelling examples (EMME) are instructional videos (e.g., tutorials) that visualize another person’s gaze location while they demonstrate how to perform a task. This dataset belongs to a systematic literature review that aimed to provide a detailed overview of 72 articles (78 experiments) on the effects of EMME to foster observers’ learning and performance. The file 'Instructions_coded_results_table' contains the code book that was used to create the main data file 'Coded_results_table.sav'.
